Anymail is supported and maintained by the people who use it—like you!
We welcome all contributions: issue reports, bug fixes, documentation improvements,
new features, ideas and suggestions, and anything else to help improve the package.

Before posting **questions** or **issues** in GitHub, please check out
[_Getting support_][support] and [_Troubleshooting_][troubleshooting]
in the Anymail docs.

In general, **pull requests** must have a reported issue or discussion before
they will be considered. Please do not open an unsolicited PR without an issue
or discussion number. (The one exception is minor docs fixes like typos or
broken links, which don't need a reported issue.)

**AI assisted** contributions are permitted, but PRs _must_ be opened by a human
developer who has carefully reviewed the content. Please identify which AI
you used, how you used it, and how you (the human) have verified its work.
Maintainers may decide to deprioritize, ignore, or close PRs that don't follow
these guidelines.

**New ESP integrations** _must_ be proposed using the [new ESP request] issue
template. PRs for new ESPs will not be considered for merge until the request
gathers a significant level of authentic community interest.

Other **feature requests** and suggested improvements should be proposed
in the discussion forum under [Ideas]. It's always a good idea to seek feedback
in the forum before writing a lot of code (or burning AI tokens on it).

For more info on the **development** environment and **testing**,
see the [_Contributing_][contributing] section in the docs.

[contributing]: https://anymail.dev/en/stable/contributing/
[Ideas]: https://github.com/anymail/django-anymail/discussions/categories/ideas
[new ESP request]: https://github.com/anymail/django-anymail/issues/new?template=esp_request.md
[support]: https://anymail.dev/en/stable/help/#support
[troubleshooting]: https://anymail.dev/en/stable/help/#troubleshooting
